item.arsmagicalegacy.arcane_compendium.b: Air Guardian

The Air Guardian is a being of wind, and makes heavy use of knockback-based attacks. On top of that, its whirlwinds can blow off your armor if you are not careful enough. It would be foolish to go into battle without some form of falling protection.
Air Guardian Ritual

To summon the Air Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any biome above Y 128. Then, drop a $(l:blocks/flowers#tarma_root)tarma root$() at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Air Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/lightning_damage)lightning$(), and is immune to fall damage or physical projectile attacks, such as arrows.

The Air Guardian's ride, called the Air Sled, allows you to take to the sky with ease. It is quite similar to creative flight, although a little slower.$(br2)Right click the Air Sled to place it, right click again to mount it, shift while on the ground to dismount it, shift-right click with an empty hand while unmounted to retrieve it.
Arcane Guardian

A mage of ancient times, the Arcane Guardian has access to a wide variety of spells. From attacks to buffs to debuffs to self-healing, prepare for a magical duel that will test your counter-spell knowledge.
Arcane Guardian Ritual

To summon the Arcane Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any biome. Note that the lectern must face towards the sunrise (east). Then, drop an Arcane Compendium at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Arcane Guardian has no particular strengths or weaknesses. Attack it in any way you like. Melee is generally a bad idea, though.

Imbued with unknowable enchantments by ancient mages, the Arcane Spell Book dropped by the Arcane Guardian increases the effectiveness and lowers the mana cost of all spells cast from it.$(br2)Imbued with lots of its guardian's magic, the Arcane Spell Book inherits Netherite's fire-proof properties.
Earth Guardian
The heavy Earth Guardian will rip rocks from the earth to hurl them at you. If you get close to it, it will beat you up, or pound the earth so hard that you are blown back by a shockwave.
Earth Guardian Ritual

To summon the Earth Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any biome. Then, drop an emerald, a piece of $(l:blocks/ores#chimerite)chimerite$() and a $(l:blocks/ores#topaz)topaz$() at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Earth Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/drowning_damage)drowning$() and $(l:components/frost_damage)frost$(), and is immune to $(l:components/fire_damage)fire$() and $(l:components/lightning_damage)lightning$().

The Earth Armor is the chest of the Earth Guardian. It offers significant physical damage resistance for a single piece of armor, and adds a sizeable amount of damage (+4) to all strikes.$(br2)As the Earth Guardian is immune to fire, so is this armor.
Ender Guardian

Tales are told in hushed whispers of the true Ender Guardian. Of eyes glowing with an abhorrent light, and scaly skin as black as a moonless night. Alas, the tales of this waking nightmare are vague at best and always shrouded in the veil of speculation. The only thing known for sure are its fast, teleport-heavy and extremely powerful attacks.
Ender Guardian Ritual

To summon the Ender Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page anywhere in the end. Then, drop an ender eye into the Black Aurem.$(br2)A being of dark Ender magic, $(l:components/magic_damage)light Arcane magic$() will hurt it double. As an inhabitant of the End, the same is true for $(l:components/drowning_damage)water$().

The Ender Boots are rumored to be dropped from the Ender Guardian. When wearing these boots, jumping will reverse gravity. This will only apply to you, and you will fall upwards. Normal falling damage applies.$(br2)Imbued with lots of dark magic, the Ender Boots inherit Netherite's fire-proof properties.
Fire Guardian

The Fire Guardian is a living inferno from the depths of the nether. After setting its surroundings ablaze, the fire makes it hard to still see the guardian, allowing it to attack from nowhere. It will also melt down your armor in seconds. Prepare for a fight!
Fire Guardian Ritual

To summon the Fire Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page anywhere in the nether. Then, drop a $(l:entities/water_guardian)water essence$() at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Fire Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/drowning_damage)drowning$(), and is immune to $(l:components/fire_damage)fire$() and $(l:components/frost_damage)frost$().

The Fire Antennae dropped by the Fire Guardian grant fire immunity, allow you to swim in lava when worn in the helmet or head curio slot, and counteract the push of flowing lava.$(br2)Like Netherite equipment, the Fire Antennae are fire-proof.
Ice Guardian

The super-cold Ice Guardian does not bother with ranged attacks. Instead, it launches his arm to capture its target, then reel it in to harm it in combat. Similar to its Earth counterpart, the Ice Guardian can and will create shockwaves.
Ice Guardian Ritual

To summon the Ice Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any frozen or snowy biome. Make sure to place the pumpkin last, so that the Snow Golem can transform into the Ice Guardian.$(br2)The Ice Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/fire_damage)fire$(), and is immune to $(l:components/frost_damage)frost$().

Taken from the Ice Guardian, its arm - called the Winter's Grasp - can be used as a blunt weapon. It retains its unearthly chill, and any foe struck with it will start to freeze. Alternatively, it can be thrown, and will pull back an entity to you if it is hit by the arm, applying the same freeze effect.
Life Guardian

The Life Guardian does not attack much on its own, though it may decide to nauseate you. It generally prefers to let others do the fighting for it, infusing them with its tremendous power. In return, the others will often lay down their lives for the guardian's protection. The Life Guardian is a different kind of fight than the other bosses.
Life Guardian Ritual

To summon the Life Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any biome. Then, during a full moon night, kill a villager child at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Life Guardian cannot be damaged directly. Defeat its minions, and the guardian will be hurt.

The Life Ward is dropped from the Life Guardian. When in your inventory, you will slowly generate a shield equal to up to 20 hit points around you that will absorb incoming damage. The hit points remain if the Life Ward is removed from your inventory, but will not replenish themselves without it.
Lightning Guardian

The Lightning Guardian is as unpredictable as it is powerful. Its feared telekinetic attack uses a massive amount of concentrated static electricity, which leaves the unfortunate victim open to several other effects. On rare occasions, it manages to mess with its victim's synapses, making their movement really awkward.
Lightning Guardian Ritual

To summon the Lightning Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any biome. Then, wait for a storm and have lightning strike the rod.$(br2)The Lightning Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/drowning_damage)drowning$(), and will be healed by incoming $(l:components/lightning_damage)lightning$() damage.

The Lightning Charm is dropped from the Lightning Guardian. Right click it in your inventory to toggle it on and off. When on, or when used by hand, its static electricity draws in nearby items automatically.
Nature Guardian

The Nature Guardian is a fearsome opponent. Boasting a deadly scythe and the skill to use it, only the most powerful or foolish would seek it out. It is just as dangerous at range as in melee, if not more.

Unlike all other bosses, the Nature Guardian appears to avenge dryads when enough are slain in quick succession. Nature can be harsh, but it will not tolerate a massacre.$(br2)The Nature Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/fire_damage)fire$() and $(l:components/frost_damage)frost$(), and will be healed instead of $(l:components/drowning_damage)drowned$().
Taken from the Nature Guardian, this scythe wields immense power. It can be used as a heavy melee weapon, or thrown like a boomerang, dealing large amounts of damage either way.
Water Guardian

The Water Guardian is a unique being. This trickster will create copies of itself, attacking from ambush if you are fooled by the decoy. If you come too close, it will begin to spin and use its tentacles to damage you. If you keep your distance, it will attack you with water projectiles.
Water Guardian Ritual

To summon the Water Guardian, build the structure seen on the previous page in any water-based biome. Then, drop a water bucket and a boat at the center of the circle.$(br2)The Water Guardian takes double damage from $(l:components/lightning_damage)lightning$(), and is immune to $(l:components/drowning_damage)drowning$(). If the guardian has copies, they will absorb the damage and be destroyed in the process.

The Water Orbs dropped by the Water Guardian allow you to control water subconsciously. While wearing them in the leggings or belt curio slot, you will not be pushed by flowing water, have infinite breath while underwater, and move faster in water as if you had a dolphin's grace.
